name: Leslie Ashbrook
source: The player character. The protagonist is the second child of the current Earl of Hartwood. They are a well-meaning, cheerful, and romantic sort. They can’t help but be honest, and have a hard time lying. At the beginning of the game, they are in love with Heron Renaude, and forced their way into the house party at Reedford Manor for their chance at wooing the man.
